changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE agent_action DROP CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_kind, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_kind CHECK (kind IN ('EMAIL','FILE_ISSUE','DELIVER_FEEDBACK','EDIT_FEEDBACK', 'RETRACT_FEEDBACK','SLACK_POST','PUBLISH_REPORT')), DROP CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_workspace, ADD CONSTRAINT ck_agent_action_workspace CHECK (workspace_id IS NOT NULL OR kind IN ('EMAIL','FILE_ISSUE','PUBLISH_REPORT')); -- A /publish that waited for the next promotion tick becomes the command's action, in the report's filing lane. INSERT INTO agent_action (id, kind, lane_key, idempotency_key, state, payload, subject_account_id, max_attempts, next_attempt_at, created_at, updated_at) SELECT uuidv7(), 'PUBLISH_REPORT', 'file_issue:' || f.feedback_id, 'publish_report:' || f.feedback_id || ':' || floor(extract(epoch FROM f.publish_requested_at) * 1000)::bigint, 'ADMITTED', jsonb_build_object('feedbackId', f.feedback_id), p.account_id, 5, clock_timestamp(), clock_timestamp(), clock_timestamp() FROM product_feedback_filing f JOIN product_feedback p ON p.id = f.feedback_id WHERE f.publish_requested_by IS NOT NULL AND f.publish_requested_at IS NOT NULL;
